data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'k-m-l' meaning 'to perfect' or 'to complete'. Kamalah is a name evoking the concept of reaching the highest level of spiritual and personal growth in Islam. The name Kamalah carries the meaning “Perfection, completion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kamalah usually hope their child will grow to embody perfection, completion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
